---
title: "Vacant Parcels Owned by Public Entities"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(mapgl)
library(glue)
library(scales)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)

# --- Mapbox basemap + token --------------------------------------------------
# Basemap is the CPAL Mapbox style the original 2023 map used. A client-side GL
# map must embed a token in the rendered page, so this MUST be a PUBLIC (pk.*)
# token — reuse the same publishable token the live page already exposes (owned
# by the michaelcpal account that owns this style, URL-restricted; never a secret
# sk.* token). Kept in .env (gitignored) as MAPBOX_TOKEN; bridged to the name
# mapgl expects.
Sys.setenv(MAPBOX_PUBLIC_TOKEN = Sys.getenv("MAPBOX_TOKEN"))
if (!nzchar(Sys.getenv("MAPBOX_PUBLIC_TOKEN"))) {
  stop("Set MAPBOX_TOKEN in .env to the published Mapbox public (pk.*) token.")
}
cpal_style <- "mapbox://styles/michaelcpal/clqzkwbw800sw01nv90032l7z"

# --- Vintages (data-driven) --------------------------------------------------
# To add 2026: append one row and drop its PMTiles into docs/. No other change.
# `pmtiles` are served from docs/ by GitHub Pages (range requests). `geojson`
# is read at render time only, to compute the header counts.
vintages <- tibble::tribble(
  ~year,  ~label,  ~geojson,                                ~pmtiles,                          ~is_default,
  2023L,  "2023",  "data/public-vacant-land_2023.geojson",  "public-vacant-land_2023.pmtiles",  FALSE,
  2025L,  "2025",  "data/public-vacant-land_2025.geojson",  "public-vacant-land_2025.pmtiles",  TRUE
)
# Only include vintages whose data has actually been built, so a partial build
# (e.g. 2023 only, before the warehouse-sourced 2025 lands) previews cleanly.
available <- file.exists(vintages$geojson)
if (!any(available)) {
  stop("No vintage GeoJSON found. Build one first: scripts/prep_2023.R for 2023, ",
       "or the join script for a warehouse vintage.")
}
vintages <- vintages[available, ]
default_year <- if (any(vintages$is_default)) vintages$year[vintages$is_default][1] else vintages$year[1]

# --- Ownership groups + palette (from the original map fills) -----------------
group_palette <- c(
  "CITY OF DALLAS"            = "#008097",
  "DALLAS COUNTY"            = "#E98816",
  "DART"                     = "#1E4A4A",
  "DALLAS COLLEGE"           = "#F7314C",
  "DALLAS ISD"               = "#EA8B98",
  "DALLAS HOUSING AUTHORITY" = "#851E2C",
  "MULTIPLE OWNERS"          = "#EACA2D"
)
groups <- names(group_palette)
slug   <- function(x) tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", x))

# --- Per-vintage, per-group counts for the header cards ----------------------
# Reads the (gitignored, locally-present) geojson build outputs. Emitted to the
# page as JSON so the picker can update the cards client-side.
vintage_stats <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(vintages)), function(i) {
  v <- vintages[i, ]
  if (!file.exists(v$geojson)) {
    warning(glue("Missing {v$geojson}; run the join script for {v$year}."))
    return(list(year = v$year, total = 0, by_group = as.list(setNames(rep(0, length(groups)), groups))))
  }
  d <- sf::st_read(v$geojson, quiet = TRUE) |> sf::st_drop_geometry()
  by_group <- sapply(groups, function(g) sum(d$OWNERSHIP_GROUP == g, na.rm = TRUE))
  list(year = v$year, total = nrow(d), by_group = as.list(by_group))
})
names(vintage_stats) <- as.character(vintages$year)
stats_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(vintage_stats, auto_unbox = TRUE)

fmt <- function(n) scales::comma(n)
def <- vintage_stats[[as.character(default_year)]]
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Expose counts + config to the client for the vintage picker.
cat(as.character(tags$script(HTML(glue(
  "window._VPL = {{ stats: {stats_json}, defaultYear: {default_year} }};"
)))))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Right-hand count rows, one per ownership group. IDs let the picker update them.
rows <- vapply(groups, function(g) {
  as.character(tags$h4(
    tags$div(class = "rounded-outline",
             tags$b(id = glue("vpl-count-{slug(g)}"), fmt(def$by_group[[g]]))),
    HTML(glue(" listed as <span style='color: {group_palette[[g]]};'>{tools::toTitleCase(tolower(g))}</span>"))
  ))
}, character(1))
cat('<div class="right-card-col"><div style="width: 3%"></div><div class="card-side">')
cat(paste(rows, collapse = "\n"))
cat('</div></div>')
```

::::

:::

The map below shows vacant land within the City of Dallas owned by public agencies
(City of Dallas, Dallas County, DART, Dallas ISD, and others), from DCAD certified
rolls. Use the vintage control to switch appraisal years; toggle agencies in the
layer control.

```{=html}
<div id="vpl-vintage-picker" class="vpl-picker" aria-label="Appraisal vintage"></div>
```

```{r}
#| label: map
#| echo: false

pmtiles_url <- function(f) f  # served from docs/ alongside index.html (relative URL)

m <- mapboxgl(style = cpal_style, center = c(-96.7970, 32.7767), zoom = 10)

# City boundary outline (tracked geojson; drawn as a reference frame).
boundary <- sf::st_read("data/City of Dallas Boundary.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(4326)
m <- m |> add_line_layer(id = "city-boundary", source = boundary,
                         line_color = "#595959", line_width = 2, line_opacity = 1)

# For each vintage x group, add a fill layer. Layers are id'd "<year>__<group>"
# so the picker can flip a whole vintage by prefix. All added visible; onRender
# hides the non-default vintages. CONFIRM add_pmtiles_source / source_layer name
# ("parcels") against how build/tile step names the tippecanoe layer.
for (i in seq_len(nrow(vintages))) {
  v <- vintages[i, ]
  src_id <- glue("src-{v$year}")
  m <- m |> add_pmtiles_source(id = src_id, url = pmtiles_url(v$pmtiles))
  for (g in groups) {
    m <- m |> add_fill_layer(
      id           = glue("{v$year}__{slug(g)}"),
      source       = src_id,
      source_layer = "parcels",
      fill_color   = unname(group_palette[[g]]),
      fill_opacity = 0.45,
      fill_outline_color = "#595959",
      filter       = list("==", list("get", "OWNERSHIP_GROUP"), g),
      tooltip      = "popup_html"   # CONFIRM: precompute a popup_html property when tiling
    )
  }
}

# Wire the vintage picker + card updates once the map is on the page.
# NOTE: this JS glue is the one piece that needs a render pass to confirm against
# the mapgl widget instance (see the front-end decision).
# glue delimiters set to << >> so the JS braces pass through untouched.
m |> htmlwidgets::onRender(glue(r"(
function(el, x) {
  var map = this.map;
  var cfg = window._VPL;
  var years = Object.keys(cfg.stats);
  var groupSlugs = <<group_slugs>>;

  function setVintage(year) {
    years.forEach(function(y) {
      var vis = (String(y) === String(year)) ? 'visible' : 'none';
      groupSlugs.forEach(function(gs) {
        var id = y + '__' + gs.slug;
        if (map.getLayer(id)) map.setLayoutProperty(id, 'visibility', vis);
      });
    });
    var s = cfg.stats[String(year)];
    document.getElementById('vpl-total').textContent = s.total.toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById('vpl-vintage-label').textContent = year;
    groupSlugs.forEach(function(gs) {
      var c = document.getElementById('vpl-count-' + gs.slug);
      if (c) c.textContent = (s.by_group[gs.name] || 0).toLocaleString();
    });
  }

  var picker = document.getElementById('vpl-vintage-picker');
  years.forEach(function(y) {
    var id = 'vpl-radio-' + y;
    var wrap = document.createElement('label');
    wrap.className = 'vpl-radio';
    var input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'radio'; input.name = 'vpl-vintage'; input.value = y; input.id = id;
    if (String(y) === String(cfg.defaultYear)) input.checked = true;
    input.addEventListener('change', function() { setVintage(y); });
    wrap.appendChild(input);
    wrap.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ' + y));
    picker.appendChild(wrap);
  });

  map.on('load', function() { setVintage(cfg.defaultYear); });
}
)", group_slugs = jsonlite::toJSON(
       lapply(groups, function(g) list(name = g, slug = slug(g))), auto_unbox = TRUE),
   .open = "<<", .close = ">>"))
```
